## Current Focus

I work in clinical genomics while pursuing an M.S. in Bioinformatics and developing experience in Python, biological data analysis, scientific computing, and reproducible computational workflows.

My background combines high-throughput genetic testing with project experience in functional gene annotation, extracellular RNA biomarker research, spatial biology visualization, and biodiversity data.
